title: Deliver Acarat expansion products over the canonical real-estate lifecycle
outcome: Acarat extends the proven marketplace, intelligence, customer, agent, property, deal, and contract foundations into investment analytics, property management, off-plan/developer operations, financing/payment integrations, and enterprise data products without creating parallel truth stores or unearned regulatory authority.
rationale: Program-level future-scope child spanning roadmap P22-P26. It preserves accepted Acarat scope but is not executable until each product family is separately refined and its regulatory/economic prerequisites are proven.
scope_in: P25 financing, deposits, and regulated payment rails
P26 enterprise dashboards and governed data products
scope_out: Acarat acting as a bank or lender without authority
Acarat holding escrow funds without authority
acceptance: Each P22-P26 product family is refined into bounded Grains with reuse of canonical property/customer/deal identities, explicit regulatory/provider authority, source/data rights, privacy, financial reconciliation where applicable, metric semantics, negative cases, rollback, and evidence.

risk.recovery: Planning child only; no financing, fund custody, off-plan reservation, or external data product is authorized by this specification.
